title: Map Service State
description: Transforms pipeline data by applying a declarative template to produce a new JSON object. (Runtimes: browser, cpp, node, python; IDs: hookup.to/service/map, map)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

template.description: The mapping template. See Template Syntax above.

mode.description: Controls how the output is merged with the input.

arrayMode.description: Whether an array input is mapped element by element or as one value.

sensingMode.description: When true, the Map auto-learns the template from the first input then disables itself.
